Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High.
He is the One who created and shaped everything perfectly.
He is the One who planned everything and then guided it.
He is the One who brings out the green pasture.
Then makes it dark, dry stubble.
We will make you recite, and you will not forget.
Except what Allah wills. He knows what is open and what is hidden.
And We will make the way easy for you.
So remind people, if the reminder helps.
The one who fears Allah will take the reminder.
And the unhappy one will stay away from it.
He will enter the great Fire.
He will neither die in it nor live a good life.
Successful is the one who cleans himself.
And remembers his Lord's name and prays.
But you prefer the life of this world.
While the next life is better and lasts longer.
This is in the earlier scrolls.
The scrolls of Ibrahim and Musa.
